study.question: Observed validation macro AUCs: baseline-din 0.8099233881, behavior 0.8136963424, count-scaled 0.8142997579, pooled 0.8166562308, recency 0.8183804941. All four round-0 models used the same 32,452,293 parameters and approximately 348-359 s per complete unit; the adapted DIN used 32,059,429 parameters and 329 s. The semantic behavior-content hypothesis did not beat its counts replacement or pooled/recency alternatives. Recency versus pooled gains 0.0017242633 macro AUC, but increases macro Logloss from 0.0560873890 to 0.0564532641 and cart Logloss from 0.0193428171 to 0.0210536814; no task veto is imposed. Recency versus pooled has history-length slice AUC differences -0.0032925606 for length 1-16, +0.0012521825 for 17-64, and +0.0039583864 for >64. These exploratory single-seed contrasts do not isolate a mechanism. Source inspection shows each recency summary concatenates six item fields plus action (112 dimensions) and projects it into a single 32-dimensional token. Does exposing complementary field groups as separate interaction tokens help at matched token count and capacity, and does its effect depend on temporal partitioning? No embedding-frequency, hour, unseen-field or behavior-composition diagnostics were supplied, so none is inferred. Dataset identity/readiness is inherited from frozen host receipts, not newly reverified from raw data in this coding environment.
study.hypothesis: The one-token-per-temporal-summary representation may mix ad identity, category/brand and price/action evidence too early for subsequent heterogeneous interaction. Giving these three disjoint groups separate tokens should improve validation macro AUC relative to equally many whole-summary replicas; the advantage may be larger with temporal quartiles. This is a provisional compression/routing hypothesis, not an observed cause. It does not restore event-level detail, change the shared event scorer, or claim semantic grouping is uniquely optimal.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived primary text lines 268-283 and 317-335: inherit target-conditioned unnormalized local activation and Dice from the adapted baseline. Add controlled field-group/temporal-summary interaction; no exact DIN reproduction claim.

Pinned source lines 113-159 pools once, reshapes the pooled vector into field embeddings, applies field tokenization and appends task tokens. Field tokenization is prior work. Here preserve global plus four temporal summaries, select three disjoint field groups using fixed coordinate masks before a shared projection, and compare whole-summary replicas in a 2x2 factorial. Retain the existing one-block attention and flattened four-tower readout rather than heterogeneous hierarchical blocks/task queries. Original HiFormer paper is link-only in the registry; originality remains unverified.

Pinned forward lines 122-158 pools once then permits field-shaped or concatenated input tokenization and token mixing. Do not assume it is limited to chunks. Current difference is controlled multi-temporal field-group content assignment with explicit masked attention; this is not a RankMixer reproduction or demonstrated improvement over it.

Primary benchmark section 2.3 confirms existing stacked field/group tokens, temporal mixed queries and direct event interaction families. Those broad ideas are inherited prior art, not new claims. This study only identifies local value of a specific compact representation replacement under the frozen released input protocol.

study.proposed_difference: For each of five pooled summaries h_s in R^112, construct three vectors h_s multiplied by fixed coordinate selections: {item_id,campaign_id,customer_id}, {cate_id,brand}, {price_bucket,action}. Append the same log count to each and use the same existing 113-to-32 shared projection; flatten slot then group to fifteen tokens. The matched replacement feeds h_s/sqrt(3) to each of the three token positions, with the same projection, identities, masks and towers. The selection masks are non-trainable buffers with the same shape in every variant. Equal total pre-projection squared content norm limits a trivial energy difference; it does not match per-token distributions or learned projection rank. Cross grouped versus replica content with global-plus-quartiles versus five identical global summaries. All four use exactly the same parameter shapes and operation shapes; static tokens and raw global summary are identical pathways. The larger scaffold adds ten tokens and 164,160 trainable parameters relative to the existing recency parent at declared widths (estimated total 32,616,453; dense 823,237; embeddings 31,793,216). These are source-derived counts pending host measurement. The full model remains a compact stacked summary interaction adaptation. No new data, label semantics, task weighting, optimizer setting, loss hook or external source is introduced.
predictions: Primary: grouped_recency macro AUC exceeds replica_recency on the complete frozen validation set; select using equal-weight four-task macro AUC, then macro Logloss, parameter count and trial ID. Report all four AUC and Logloss deltas against both baseline-din and g0-r0000-recency_slots, including regressions.

Factorial: compute D_recency=AUC(grouped_recency)-AUC(replica_recency), D_pooled=AUC(grouped_pooled)-AUC(replica_pooled), and interaction D_recency-D_pooled. Positive D_recency alone supports only that cell; positive differences in both contexts suggest a broader decomposition effect; positive interaction suggests complementarity with temporal partitioning.

Exploratory: temporal complementarity is expected mainly in non-empty, longer histories; use existing bins empty, 1-16, 17-64 and >64. Report each slice sample/positive/negative counts, and mark low-positive slices insufficient. Empty-history gains cannot be attributed to history content.

Matched cells have identical parameter count and similar measured training/inference cost; any claimed efficiency needs measured cost/quality comparison with the parent and DIN rather than an AUC-only comparison. Logloss improvement is desirable but not guaranteed by ranking gains.
falsifiers: D_recency <= 0 leaves the proposed replacement unsupported at the inherited recency setting; all grouped cells losing to their matched replicas weakens this implementation in both tested temporal contexts. Do not call one seed a general mechanism refutation.
If replicas improve over the existing recency parent while grouping adds no matched gain, attribute the practical gain to the enlarged scaffold/optimization rather than field decomposition.
If D_recency-D_pooled <= 0, the temporal-complementarity prediction is unsupported even if a field decomposition main effect is positive.

If gains are confined to empty histories, appear only after undeclared slice/metric selection, reverse on admissible paired repetitions, or fail finite-gradient/masking checks, do not claim robust history-representation support.
alternative_explanations: Single-seed variance and validation adaptation; all existing successful trials were one-seed observations, not independent repeated mechanism evidence. No failed executions are reported in the supplied five-trial trajectory; do not invent any.

Semantic behavior grouping failed to beat its controls, but that tests one implementation and does not refute feedback-aware representations in general. TokenMixer/HeMix/TokenFormer declarations in the previous usage record are provenance rather than demonstrated causal benefits.

Grouped content has different per-token distribution, rank and information allocation from replicas despite matched trainable count, total input content energy and token count. An arbitrary-coordinate partition or invertible rotation control would be needed to establish semantic field-boundary specificity; that claim is out of scope here.

Raw global/static bypasses and flattened towers can exploit complementary projected content without attention routing being causal. A no-interaction control would be necessary before claiming JointBlock attention is the source of gain.

Recency bins use visible sequence ranks, not actual elapsed time. Short histories change bin occupancy and scale; recency versus pooled also changes counts/validity, so the temporal contrast tests that whole representation rather than pure order alone.

Category/brand-aligned auxiliary labels may favor the category/brand grouping; results do not establish ad-specific conversion attribution or production point-in-time validity. Historical delayed feedback may be immature under official_offline.

All new variants have 164,160 more parameters than the parent; only within-factorial comparisons isolate the tested representation at matched trainable capacity. Same data passes and tensor shapes do not establish equal measured cost or an equal-compute frontier.

cost_plan.stop_rule: No training or installation in this propose-phase coding environment. Submit standalone sources and proposal for host execution. Stop at hard limits; no performance or mechanism claim from unexecuted code.
